description: Cluster health from mm_alerts. If Open alerts is non-empty the system is reporting itself unhealthy. The Strategies page Data column mirrors this.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(opened_at_ms / 1000.0) AS opened_at, severity, summary, fingerprint FROM mm_alerts WHERE resolved_at_ms IS NULL ORDER BY opened_at_ms DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT to_timestamp(opened_at_ms / 1000.0) AS time, CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 2 WHEN 'degraded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS severity FROM mm_alerts WHERE to_timestamp(opened_at_ms / 1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_timestamp(opened_at_ms / 1000.0) AS opened_at, CASE WHEN resolved_at_ms IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_timestamp(resolved_at_ms / 1000.0) END AS resolved_at, severity, summary FROM mm_alerts WHERE to_timestamp(opened_at_ms / 1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY opened_at_ms DESC LIMIT 200

title: MM Observability v2 / 08 Cluster Health
